open_work: Bible VIII.5.g governs this period ADAPTATION of the exact variant-1 chassis. Bakelite case, brass circular bezel, cloth grille, passive valves/wet cells and braided flex retain the original pose, control datums and TOWER OF ASH owner. The wider 1.68..1.90m header and exact side-fin envelope remain as supported Bakelite side rims; the shortened closed side hatch has clearance from those rims in isolated inspection poses.

Original variant-1 maximum 1.90m, scope centre 1.345m, live quad 0.41m and control heights remain. Four feet meet the unchanged source floor top 0.01m. All eight finish keys/maps already belong to the catalogue; text remains Label3D.

Only eight exact original decorative owners (424 triangles) and their separately named 12-triangle hull retire. Every unrelated source array and neighboring collision shape/state/pose remains exact. No layout, assembler or shipping glTF edit.

All remaining original source remains conservative inspection context. This cell has no previously accepted native furnishings. Fin-rim supports, closed positive connected stock, actual floor contacts, metre charts/tangents, imported ownership/maps/collision, ordinary input, reconstruction and direct rendered inspection remain required. Passive stock and offline hatch poses grant no repair, power or service capacity.
Other Pawn furnishings, continuous standing and service access, the two Diner receiving chassis, broader services and whole-building/human acceptance remain separate open work.
